destinations.name: Bandarban
destinations.description: Hiked to Nilgiri before sunrise and watched a full sea of clouds form below the ridgeline — one of the calmest mornings I've had.
memories: Coding a small trip-log app that same evening

destinations.name: Cox's Bazar
destinations.description: The world's longest natural sea beach, best experienced at sunset with fresh grilled seafood a few steps from the sand.
destinations.storyTitle: Sunset on the world's longest beach
memories: Fresh grilled seafood on the sand

destinations.name: Kathmandu
destinations.description: A chaotic, beautiful city — temple bells, mountain air, and the best momos I've had anywhere, all within a few blocks.
destinations.storyTitle: Temple bells and momos on repeat
memories: Momo count: lost track after twelve

destinations.name: Pokhara
destinations.description: Paragliding over Phewa Lake with the Annapurna range laid out like a screensaver — ten of the calmest minutes of the year.

destinations.name: Bangkok
destinations.description: Street-food crawls by night, co-working by day. Bangkok is where I learned you can absolutely code between bites of pad kra pao.
memories: Tuk-tuk race back to the hostel

destinations.name: Bali
destinations.description: A week split between a beachfront co-working space and the shoreline. Shipped a full feature between two surf sessions.
destinations.storyTitle: A week of coding by the sea
memories: Best iced coffee of the trip

destinations.name: Istanbul
destinations.description: Two continents, one city. Spent most evenings on a rooftop overlooking the Bosphorus with a cup of Turkish tea.

destinations.name: Dubai
destinations.description: A short layover turned into a 3-day detour through the desert, the old souks, and far too many rooftop coffee shops.
destinations.storyTitle: A layover that became a desert detour
memories: Karak chai in the old souk

destinations.name: Colombo
destinations.description: Fresh seafood, colonial architecture, and a train ride along the coast that's still one of my favorite train rides ever.
destinations.storyTitle: A coastal train ride I still think about
memories: Fresh king coconut at every stop

destinations.name: Rara Lake
destinations.description: Nepal's largest lake, tucked deep in the far west — remote, still, and near the top of my wishlist for a slower kind of trip.

destinations.name: Kuang Si Falls
destinations.description: Turquoise, multi-tiered waterfalls outside Luang Prabang — the kind of place that ends up on every 'someday' list.

destinations.name: Swiss Alps
destinations.description: Cliché, yes — but a train through the Alps with a laptop open on the tray table is basically the dream remote-work day.

destinations.name: Kyoto
destinations.description: Temples, tea houses, and (from what I hear) some of the best vending-machine coffee on Earth.

destinations.name: Patagonia
destinations.description: About as far from a desk as I could possibly get. Multi-day trekking, glaciers, and zero notifications.

travelMotivations.quote: The world is a book, and those who do not travel read only one page.
travelMotivations.author: Saint Augustine

travelMotivations.quote: Travel far enough, you meet yourself.
travelMotivations.author: David Mitchell

travelMotivations.quote: Not all those who wander are lost.
travelMotivations.author: J.R.R. Tolkien

travelMotivations.quote: Once a year, go someplace you've never been before.
travelMotivations.author: Dalai Lama

travelMotivations.quote: Adventure may hurt you, but monotony will kill you.
travelMotivations.author: Unknown
